text:
Livestream Menu Make It select USA INTL Livestream Search quotes, news & videos Livestream Watchlist SIGN IN Create free account Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu
Home Depot on Tuesday reported fiscal second-quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines and reaffirmed its full fiscal-year guidance.
"We continue to operate in what I call 'frozen housing market conditions,' but we also know that we're taking share and that we're serving our customers better every day," CFO Richard McPhail told CNBC. "It's a reflection of the continued investment we've made and the focus on executing our strategy."
McPhail said Home Depot saw "broad engagement" across its categories, including in both its pro and do-it-yourself businesses, but the greater uncertainty in the market led the company to reaffirm rather than raise its guidance.
He added that Home Depot's customer is "a healthy cohort," though he said the company has still not seen consumers return to big projects.
"They've told us they have the means to spend, they're just hesitant," he told CNBC. "While we're happy with their level of engagement in the first half, they do tell us they're worried about inflation, about fuel costs and about, about general uncertainty, and so there is a little bit of hesitancy there as the project gets bigger."
Here's how Home Depot performed in its fiscal second quarter compared with what Wall Street was expecting, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:
The home improvement retailer reported net income of $4.77 billion, or $4.79 per share, compared with $4.55 billion, or $4.58 per share, the year prior. Excluding one-time items, Home Depot reported adjusted earnings per share of $4.92. Revenue rose 5.7% to $47.86 billion.
Home Depot saw comparable sales rise 1.7%, beating expectations that they would be up 0.9%, according to StreetAccount. McPhail said it is the highest comparable sales number the company has posted since the fiscal third quarter of 2022.
Home Depot also reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance, which it said includes tariff refunds that are "expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs." McPhail added that the tariff refunds allow the retailer to "maintain value" despite cost pressures in other areas.
On a call with analysts on Tuesday, McPhail said the company received $730 million in tariff refunds during the second quarter, which he said represent "the vast majority" of what the company is expecting. He added that Home Depot used $685 million of those refunds to reduce the cost of goods sold, with the remaining $45 million sitting in inventory.
The company said it expects total sales growth for the year to be between 2.5% and 4.5% and operating margin between 12.4% and 12.6%.
"The story of the quarter is a story of share gain with the pro and the consumer, and we're confident that our investments are working to allow us to win in the market," McPhail told CNBC.
Home Depot has been pressured by lower housing turnover, higher mortgage rates and economic uncertainty as customers have put off projects that come with buying a new home. Still, the company has been trying to attract more pro shoppers, a cohort that executives have previously said is largely unaffected by the macroeconomic conditions.
"We're focused on controlling what we can control," McPhail told CNBC. "We have been consistent through the years that in spite of a frozen housing environment, we're going to keep leaning into investment because we know that over the long run, conditions for home improvement demand are strong."
The company also announced last week that CEO Ted Decker is taking a "temporary medical leave of absence" for a few months. Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India Jagmeet Singh 6:45 AM PDT · August 18, 2026 Perplexity spent the past year running one of the biggest AI growth experiments, giving its premium service away to customers of Indian telecom giant Airtel . Now, as the earliest of those free subscriptions expire, the results are starting to emerge, offering an early test of whether bundling paid AI services can create lasting users and revenue after the giveaway ends.
In July 2025, Perplexity partnered with Airtel, India’s second biggest telecom operator, to offer a free 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about $200, to the Indian carrier’s 360 million customers. New redemptions ended on January 16 . However, because subscribers retained Pro for a year from activation, the earliest users began reaching the end of their free access last month and had to opt out of auto-renewal if they did not want to be charged.
Perplexity’s AI giveaway had an immediate impact, as it saw 5.9 million app downloads in India in July 2025, according to data Sensor Tower shared with TechCrunch. That was up 625% from the previous month and more downloads in a single month than the 5.4 million Perplexity had accumulated during the entire first half of the year.
This momentum was not limited to the launch month of the Perplexity offer but persisted well beyond it. Perplexity recorded 56 million downloads during the seven months that the offer was available to new users, more than nine times the preceding seven-month period, Sensor Tower estimated. Monthly active users more than doubled to 8.9 million in July and eventually peaked at 22 million in October.
India has long been a massive market for downloads for global technology companies, thanks to its vast population, more than a billion internet subscribers, and relatively low mobile data costs. The country is the world’s second-largest smartphone market after China — with over 700 million users — and has similarly emerged as a major source of users for generative AI services. That scale has, however, proved considerably harder to translate into revenue.
Specifically for AI companies willing to subsidize access in pursuit of scale, India’s market dynamics have made it an attractive testing ground. Anthropic , Google , OpenAI , and others have increasingly chased Indian consumers with India-specific , lower-cost plans , free access, and distribution partnerships, aiming to eventually translate them into paying customers.
However, once the window to claim the free Airtel subscription closed in January, Perplexity’s downloads fell sharply. Sensor Tower estimates Perplexity was downloaded 3.3 million times in India between February and July, down more than 90% from the preceding six months.
The users Perplexity had acquired did not disappear quite so quickly. Monthly active users, which peaked at about 22 million in October, stood at nearly 14 million in July — down 37% from that high but still more than five times the about 2.6 million monthly users Perplexity averaged in the first half of 2025, per Sensor Tower.
“While the time-sensitive nature of this promotion would naturally lead to a decline in adoption after the offer period, ongoing usage has remained resilient,” Abe Yousef, senior insights analyst at Sensor Tower, told TechCrunch. Perplexity, he added, has “significantly more users” in India than it did in the six months before the promotion.

Transport Ebikes Electric Motorcycles Bus Hyperloop Autonomy Tesla Autopilot Cruise Automation Uber Waymo Energy Green Energy Climate Tesla Shop Store Toggle dark mode ebikes review Ride1Up unveils new and improved $895 Portola 02 folding e-bike – and I tested it Micah Toll | Aug 18 2026 - 6:46 am PT 0 Comments Ride1Up’s Portola has been one of those e-bikes that make a lot of sense on paper: a compact folding design, useful cargo capability, and the kind of pricing that helped Ride1Up build its reputation for high-value e-bikes in the first place.
Upon its initial release nearly three years ago , the Portola was obviously a shot across the bow of the massively popular 20″ wheel folding e-bike market. And now with a major update to the winning model, Ride1Up has shown that they’re here to compete in the booming category.
That’s right, the company is back with the second-generation Portola 02, and I’ve spent the last couple of days riding an early production example ahead of today’s launch.
That isn’t enough saddle time for me to call this a full review, but it is enough to get a pretty good feel for what has changed compared to the original. And while the new Portola still follows the same basic formula (750W motor, 20×3″ wheels, up to 28 mph/45 km/h for Class 3 operation), several of the upgrades make a surprisingly noticeable difference out on the road.
The biggest change, at least from the saddle, is the new pedal-assist system.
Ride1Up has equipped the Portola 02 with its Intui-Drive system, which combines torque and cadence sensing. The original Portola was already a fun little utility bike, but this new setup gives the bike a more refined and natural feeling when pedaling. Instead of assistance simply kicking in based on whether the pedals are turning, the bike can also respond to how hard you’re actually pedaling.
Over my first few rides, the Portola 02 simply felt more responsive and intuitive, especially when starting from a stop or modulating my effort at lower speeds. It still has the easygoing, accessible feel you’d expect from this style of e-bike, but now the power delivery feels a bit more sophisticated.
Ride1Up also redesigned the frame and rear cargo setup. The Portola 02 can be had with a heavy-duty removable rear rack, though the two frame configurations now available let you decide whether to go with or without a welded-on rack.
That’s a nice change for a bike like this because the Portola straddles the line between folding e-bike and compact utility e-bike. Some riders are going to want to load it up and use that rear end for serious cargo duty, while others may prefer a cleaner, lighter setup. With one model, Ride1Up now gets to serve both types of riders
Speaking of lighter, that’s a big part of the launch since there are actually two range versions of the bike, thanks to the choice between a smaller 10Ah and larger 15Ah battery. With the bigger battery, the company says the bike can get up to 60 miles (96 km) of range in pedal assist (though if you use the throttle, expect lower figures).
The Portola 02 with a 15Ah LG battery weighs 59 lb (26.7 kg), while the Portola Lite with a smaller 10Ah LG battery drops the weight to 52 lb (23.6 kg).
Seven pounds (3.1 kg) may not sound like a massive difference until you remember that this is a folding e-bike. If you’re buying one specifically because you expect to regularly pick it up, stuff it into a trunk, carry it up a few stairs, or maneuver it around an apartment, seven pounds absolutely matters.

text:
Variety Plus Icon Click to expand the Mega Menu Plus Icon Click to Expand Search Input Variety Plus Icon Read Next: Oscars: Taiwan Selects ‘A Foggy Tale’ for International Feature Race Home Film Global Aug 18, 2026 6:59am PT Nicolas Altmayer, Beloved French Producer Behind ‘OSS 117,’ and Dior Executive Mathilde Favier Die in Car Crash
International Correspondent
Nicolas Altmayer , the prolific French producer behind the “OSS 117” franchise and films by François Ozon, Bertrand Bonello and Julia Ducournau, and his partner Mathilde Favier , a prominent Dior public relations executive, died Monday in a car accident in western France. Altmayer was 61 and Favier was 57.
The couple were killed at around 4 p.m. on a departmental road in Airvault, in the Deux-Sèvres region, according to the Niort prosecutor’s office. Their vehicle “hit a heavy goods vehicle traveling in the opposite direction while they were overtaking another vehicle,” deputy prosecutor Nicolas Leclainche told AFP. An investigation for involuntary manslaughter by a driver has been opened to determine the circumstances of the crash. Related Stories Peacock Launches Test of Membership Rewards Program With Perks Including NBCU and Bravo Merch Discounts, Free Pizzas Peacock Raises Prices Across All Plans, NBCU's Fourth Increase in Four Years
Le Figaro reported that Altmayer and Favier were traveling from Cabourg to the Île de Ré, where Favier owned a home. Popular on Variety
Altmayer was one of France’s most prominent independent producers. Together with his brother Éric Altmayer, he ran Mandarin & Compagnie, whose credits ranged from hit French comedies to films by some of the country’s leading auteurs.
Among his best-known productions were Michel Hazanavicius’ “OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies” and “OSS 117: Lost in Rio,” both starring Jean Dujardin, as well as “Brice de Nice” starring Dujardin. He also produced a long string of films by Ozon, including “Young & Beautiful,” “The New Girlfriend,” “Frantz,” “By the Grace of God,” “Summer of 85” and “Everything Went Fine.”
His credits also included Bonello’s “Saint Laurent” as well as Ducournau’s “Alpha” and “Monsieur Aznavour,” the Charles Aznavour biopic starring Tahar Rahim. In 2017, Nicolas and Éric Altmayer received the César Academy’s Daniel Toscan du Plantier Award, which honors French producers.
“A great producer has died,” filmmaker Fabien Onteniente, whose “Jet Set” and “3 Zéros” were produced by the Altmayer brothers, told AFP.
Ozon also paid tribute to Altmayer, writing on X: “Shock and sadness. Nicolas Altmayer was a great producer. A supporter and a friend.”
Franck Gastambide, who worked with Altmayer on films and the series “Validé,” described his death as a “terrible shock” in comments to Le Figaro. “For 15 years, he was not only my producer but also my mentor, the father I would have wanted to have,” Gastambide said.
Favier was an influential figure in the international fashion and celebrity worlds. After working at Prada, where she helped establish the Italian fashion house’s Paris press operation, she joined Dior in 2011 and became director of public relations for Dior Couture.
In that role, Favier worked closely with many of Dior’s high-profile ambassadors and celebrity guests, including Natalie Portman, Rihanna, Jennifer Lawrence, Anya Taylor-Joy, Camille Cottin and K-pop star Jisoo. Le Figaro described her as a “solar and influential” figure in the fashion industry.
Favier was the sister of Dior Joaillerie creative director Victoire de Castellane. In 2024, she published “Mathilde à Paris,” written with journalist Frédérique Dedet, a personal guide to the French capital. She also founded the association Esthétique & Cancer, which supports people undergoing cancer treatment through beauty and wellness programs.
Bernard Arnault, chairman and CEO of Dior parent company LVMH, said Favier had “dedicated so many years of her life to putting her passion, energy and talent at the service of the house of Dior.”

title: Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC
rss_desc: Disney's ABC has sued the FCC claiming its investigation and early broadcast licenses renewal are a 'retaliatory campaign' due to its programming.
text:
Livestream Menu Make It select USA INTL Livestream Search quotes, news & videos Livestream Watchlist SIGN IN Create free account Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu
Disney's ABC has filed a First Amendment lawsuit against the Federal Communications Commission , calling the government agency's recent investigation into the company a "retaliatory campaign" due to the nature of its programming, which has been critical of President Donald Trump.
The broadcast network filed the lawsuit on Tuesday in a district court in Washington, D.C.
It comes months after the FCC launched an early renewal of a set of ABC's broadcast station licenses, citing concerns around the company's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts.
However, that early review process came shortly after renewed political backlash against ABC following comments made by TV host Jimmy Kimmel on his late night show, which airs on the broadcast network. ABC has also faced criticism from the government around its daytime talk show, "The View."
ABC's lawsuit calls for the FCC to halt its early broadcast renewal proceedings.
The FCC didn't immediately respond to a request for comment on the lawsuit.
The agency launched its review of ABC licenses in April , years ahead of their scheduled expiration. ABC shot back in May, saying in filings that it was submitting the applications "under protest in response to an unlawful, arbitrary, and unconstitutional order" from the FCC.
FCC Chairman Brendan Carr told CNBC at the time the agency's focus was on Disney's DEI practices and that the early license renewal was not tied to First Amendment matters.
Carr was appointed by Trump to lead the federal entity meant to regulate the media and telecommunications industry. It began its investigation into Disney's stations last year for possible violations of the Communications Act of 1934 and the FCC's rules regarding its prohibition on unlawful discrimination.
On Tuesday, ABC said it "continues to face irreparable harm" from the administration, which "has been acting" through the FCC.
Last week, Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro doubled down on the company's position in a CNBC interview.
"I think you saw in our FCC filings our position on this is clear," D'Amaro told CNBC's Julia Boorstin at the time. "We're very principled on this. We're going to stand up to what we believe is journalistic and integrity, and we're not going to be told how to run that side of our business."
D'Amaro took over as CEO in March from longtime Disney chief Bob Iger.
Last week, Iger agreed to purchase a majority stake in the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers alongside Joshua Kushner, the founder of Thrive Capital and brother of Jared Kushner, who is married to Trump's daughter Ivanka.

text:

By Naman Ramachandran
Australia’s screen and games sector contributed AUD11.1 billion ($7.9 billion) to the economy in gross value added in fiscal year 2023/24 and directly employed 68,844 people in FY 2024/25, according to Screen Currency 2026, a landmark Screen Australia study.
The report singles out “ Bluey ” as the country’s most effective cultural export, citing the children’s series as the most-streamed show in the U.S. in 2025 and the most recognized Australian title among international survey respondents. Related Stories NBC Prepares for Spin-Off By Hiring Christopher Halpin as CFO Peacock Launches Test of Membership Rewards Program With Perks Including NBCU and Bravo Merch Discounts, Free Pizzas
Of the total GVA, $10.8 billion ($7.7 billion) came from screen and $317 million ($225 million) from games. Employment split similarly, with 66,080 jobs in screen and 2,764 in digital games development, a sector the report describes as Australia’s fastest-growing, with growth rates outpacing the rest of the industry. Popular on Variety
Exports reached AUD1.6 billion ($1.1 billion) in FY 2023/24, made up of $1.3 billion ($923 million) in screen exports and $323 million ($229 million) in games exports. Games exports climbed at a 15.4% average annual clip between 2016/17 and 2023/24 – more than three times the pace of screen exports, which grew at 4.7% annually since 2008/09 – and now make up roughly a fifth of the sector’s total export earnings. After a decline, royalty exports rebounded to AUD415 million ($295 million) in FY 2024/25.
Australia had 188 registered digital games businesses in FY 2021/22, growing at a 15.3% average annual clip since 2015/16, according to the report. But IP ownership across the sector remains uneven: 45% of games businesses retain full rights to their titles at first release, 15% hold partial rights and 40% own none at all. Industry stakeholders cautioned against reading too much into individual breakout hits. One games executive interviewed for the study said titles like “Untitled Goose Game,” “Unpacking” and “Hollow Knight: Silksong” tend to come from small teams that found a niche audience, adding that “success depends on a multitude of factors that are often just not in the control of game makers.”
Despite the sector’s scale, the report found a gap between how much Australians value local content and how much of it they actually consume. 84% of Australians rated local screen content as important to have access to, and 75% want more of it, but only 36% consider it easy to find, and nearly two-thirds watch it for under 30% of their total viewing time.
The report also ties local content to national identity. More than three in four Australians (77%) say quality local content leaves them feeling proud to be Australian, and 78% say it contributes to a distinctive Australian identity. Similarly, 78% say it helps preserve and share Australian culture, and 71% say it connects them to the country’s past and cultural heritage.
Minister for the Arts Tony Burke tied the findings to government policy on local content quotas. “Australians know how valuable it is to see our stories, experiences and talent on screen,” Burke said. “Australian content shapes our culture, discussions and our understanding of each other, and gives us that all-important sense of belonging.”
Burke added that the government is “working to build on the momentum of Revive” through a new National Cultural Policy, pointing to new legislation requiring streaming services to carry a minimum amount of Australian content.

title: Woman found dead in Montreal apartment, injured man considered suspect: police
rss_desc: The Service de police de la Ville de Montréal said in an update Tuesday morning that the suspect remains in hospital and no court appearance has been scheduled due to his injuries.
text:

Montreal police are reporting the city’s 16th homicide after a woman was found dead in an apartment in the Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension borough.
Police responded to the scene after receiving a 911 call Monday at approximately 2:25 p.m. reporting that a person may have been injured at an apartment building on 39th Street near Paul-Corbeil Street.
They found a man and woman with serious injuries.
The woman, 41, was pronounced dead at the scene with what police called “signs of violence” found on her upper body, possibly caused by a sharp object.
A 35-year-old man was taken to hospital in critical condition, with his injuries also suggesting they were caused by a sharp object to his upper body, police said.
Police said the man is now considered a suspect in the investigation.
The relationship between the man and woman has not been confirmed, according to authorities.
The Service de police de la Ville de Montréal said in an update Tuesday morning that the suspect remains in hospital and no court appearance has been scheduled due to the man’s condition.
SPVM’s investigation into the homicide is ongoing.
Monday’s homicide comes only a day after a 44-year-old woman was found dead in another apartment in the same borough.
In that case, police received an emergency call at 1:45 p.m. Sunday and found the woman unresponsive inside. She was pronounced dead at the scene.
A 51-year-old man, who was in a relationship with the woman, was also found with serious injuries to his upper body. He was transported to hospital in critical condition but his life is not in danger.
Both people suffered injuries that may have been caused by a sharp object.
Police identified the man as a suspect in the case. It’s being investigated as a suspected femicide and was the city’s 15th homicide.

title: Sea Ray parent Brunswick bets on AI navigation and new revenue streams to help stalling boat sales
rss_desc: Brunswick Corp. CEO David Foulkes told CNBC premium boat sales are staying afloat, while value options are lagging.
text:
Livestream Menu Make It select USA INTL Livestream Search quotes, news & videos Livestream Watchlist SIGN IN Create free account Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu
Brunswick Corp., a global leader in boat manufacturing and recreation on the water, is counting on advanced technology to help with stalling sales.
The parent company of Sea Ray, Boston Whaler and other boat brands, says advanced navigation technology and autonomous docking can take some of the complexity out of maneuvering a vessel around a crowded marina.
The bet is twofold: convince would-be buyers to dive into a market that's been sluggish — with retail sales of new vessels expected to remain subdued through 2026 — and increase aftermarket and recurring revenue through technology and software sales.
Brunswick's portfolio extends well beyond the boat brands. Its Navico Group sells marine electronics and technology, while its Mercury Marine supplies engines and maintains a parts and accessories business.
Roughly 60% of Brunswick's earnings now come from aftermarket or recurring revenue, and Roth Capital Partners analyst Scott Stember says that mix gives the company meaningful exposure beyond new boat sales.
Brunswick told investors it anticipates annual sales of 145,000 to 160,000 units by 2030. Roth characterizes that as modest recovery in demand from estimated U.S. retail sales this year of fewer than 135,000 vessels.
The sluggish demand is being felt most in Brunswick's least expensive models.
"We're seeing premium boats and what we call our core portfolio being very resilient," CEO David Foulkes told CNBC. "What we're seeing is value boats, which are more typically financed or more subject to interest rate pressures ... they're not doing badly, but they're just not doing as well as some of our more premium products."
But Brunswick could increase the amount of electronics and technology onboard, even if the number of boats sold doesn't rise dramatically.
For instance, 55% of Navico's original-equipment customers have increased their Navico content since 2023, according to the company. And Navico has launched more than 30 new products since 2025.
One of those is Simrad AutoCaptain, which helps navigate and dock boats. The business strategy makes sense: Make it easy to take the boat out, and more importantly back in, and you just might sell a bigger, more expensive boat. The company generates more business around the boat, too.
Another piece of the strategy is Freedom Boat Club — a kind of country club for boaters, with locations around the globe. Members pay a fee and monthly dues for access to vessels to take out on the water at any of the locations.
Brunswick reported during its August investor day that the club has more than tripled its membership since 2019 to more than 63,000 members. Trips and reservations have grown fourfold, while the network has expanded to more than 450 locations and a fleet of roughly 5,000 boats.
And unlike the cyclical sales of a new boat, Freedom Boat Club lands squarely inside Brunswick's recurring-revenue profile, with about 90% of the club's sales recurring and trips running 10% higher than a year ago, one indication that consumers are continuing to take to the seas even as new-boat sales remain weak.
That approach is becoming more important as Brunswick lays out ambitious financial targets without assuming a return to the industry's boom years.
The company is targeting $7 billion to $8 billion in revenue by 2030, operating margins of 10% to 13% and earnings of between $8 and $12 per share.
KeyBanc, which has a sector-weight rating on Brunswick stock, said management expects pricing, a richer premium-product mix, market-share gains and new-product innovation to help drive growth.

title: Trump’s 50% tariffs are set to hit Canada in hours. There’s still no deal
rss_desc: Unless a trade deal is reached, a fresh round of sweeping 50 per cent tariffs from U.S. President Donald Trump could hit Canada by midnight.
text:

Interesting flex from a president that said “we don’t need anything from Canada”. If thats true then why the tariff?
Screw that guy. Any concessions we make could become permanent. Canada should not allow itself to be strongarmed.

Canadian officials are facing down the clock on Tuesday as new 50 per cent tariffs from U.S. President Donald Trump are set to hit Canada within hours.
Unless a trade deal is reached, a fresh round of sweeping 50 per cent tariffs could hit Canada by midnight.
The Prime Minister’s Office said late Monday that Prime Minister Mark Carney and Trump spoke by phone about the ongoing negotiations. Neither side has disclosed details of the discussion.
Carney was in St. John’s, N.L., on Monday, where he told reporters in French that the trade talks with the U.S. were “delicate” and “intense.”
Ottawa’s efforts are being led by Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc and chief negotiator Janice Charette, who are in Washington, D.C., trying to work out a deal with their American counterparts.
LeBlanc and Charette met with U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer and U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at the U.S. Department of Commerce on Monday afternoon, LeBlanc’s office said.
This was the sixth meeting between LeBlanc and Greer in the last three weeks, as officials hope to present a draft deal to Carney and Trump for their approval before Wednesday’s tariff deadline.
Trump has vowed to hit Canada with new sweeping 50 per cent tariffs on a wide range of goods in response to what the U.S. calls “discriminatory” measures, including boycotts by Canadian provinces of American alcohol in response to the U.S. trade war launched in early 2025.
Trump signed three executive orders last month, each one using a different justification for the new tariff: the provincial and territorial boycotts on American alcohol products, Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on U.S.-made vehicles and auto parts, and quotas on American dairy imports under Canada’s supply management system.
In early 2025, numerous Canadian provinces removed U.S. alcohol from their shelves in response to Trump’s trade war and threats to make Canada the “51st state.”
Canadian officials “seek to reach a comprehensive deal that delivers for businesses, workers, farmers and families on both sides of the border,” LeBlanc’s office said.
Ottawa and Washington are “not close to signing a trade deal” and a “big gap” remains between the two sides, officials told Global News on Friday.
Global News has agreed not to identify the sources because they were not authorized to speak publicly about the trade talks.
Relief for Canada’s softwood lumber industry has emerged as a sticking point in the talks. Two sources said the Americans are not interested in reducing softwood lumber tariffs, which currently sit close to 45 per cent.
The approaching tariff deadline “adds uncertainty” for the Canadian economy and threatens “significant consequences for some affected industries and regions,” Royal Bank of Canada economists Abbey Xu and Nathan Janzen said in a note Monday.

title: PQ won’t hold Quebec sovereignty vote while Trump is president, leader says
rss_desc: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said the issue would not come to a vote before Jan. 20, 2029, the date of the end of Trump’s second term at the White House.
text:
Want to discuss? Please read our Commenting Policy first.
If you get Global News from Instagram or Facebook - that will be changing. Find out how you can still connect with us .
Paul St-Pierre Plamondon says a Parti Québécois government will not hold a vote on Quebec sovereignty while U.S. President Donald Trump remains in office.
The PQ leader took to social media Tuesday morning to reiterate his party’s priorities.
“Yes, a Parti Québécois government will consult Quebecers on Quebec independence during its first term if it is elected,” he said. “A Parti Québécois government will not hold a referendum as long as Donald Trump is president of the United States.”
St-Pierre Plamondon said the issue would not come to a vote before Jan. 20, 2029, the end of Trump’s second term at the White House.
“Because an issue as crucial as that of Quebec’s political future requires conditions that allow for an informed and serene debate,” he said. “It must not be hijacked by the upheavals of American politics, nor by the outbursts of an unpredictable president, nor by fear campaigns.”
Defusing the possibility of a referendum in the near future would allow the PQ to run based on its priorities that will benefit the people of Quebec, St-Pierre Plamondon said.
“We will bring order back to our public services by reducing bureaucracy, tackle the cost-of-living crisis effectively, respond to the housing crisis, fight homelessness, put an end to the shameless waste of public funds, take care of the physical and mental health of our people, and give Quebecers back the taste for Quebec,” he said.
The PQ leader also took the opportunity to take a jab at the governing CAQ, expressing that the next government will have “plenty of challenges” from the start of its term.
“The challenges are numerous and colossal; there is a lot of work on the table,” he said.
“Our priority remains clear: govern Quebec with consistency and restore confidence to Quebec women and men.”
Latest polling shows the PQ is leading the way ahead of the provincial election, which must be held before Oct. 5.
Numbers released as part of a Leger/Le Journal/TVA poll show 30 per cent of voters would vote for the PQ if the election were held today.
The Quebec Liberal Party follows closely behind with 24 per cent.
St-Pierre Plamondon made an appeal to anglophone voters in a letter published in the National Post last week.
He asked English-speaking voters to keep an “open mind” about his party as the election approaches, adding that he would “even ensure that the rights currently enjoyed by the English-speaking community are entrenched in the constitution.”

title: Hims & Hers CEO says FTC lawsuit misunderstands how the company works
rss_desc: Hims & Hers CEO Andrew Dudum spoke to CNBC about the FTC's lawsuit against the company, compounded GLP-1 drugs and AI.
text:
Livestream Menu Make It select USA INTL Livestream Search quotes, news & videos Livestream Watchlist SIGN IN Create free account Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu
Hims & Hers CEO Andrew Dudum defended the telehealth company amid a Federal Trade Commission lawsuit over its data sharing practices.
In a wide-ranging exclusive interview aired Tuesday, Dudum contended the allegations stemmed from a misunderstanding of how the company is altering healthcare.
"I can't say much other than the fact that, you know when you're changing the fundamental understanding of how a traditional system like healthcare works, and you're rebuilding it in the digital ecosystem," he told Andrew Ross Sorkin on CNBC's "Squawk Box." "I think it takes time for people to understand how to do that the right way, and we've worked for many years with the FTC to walk them through that. And I think ultimately they wanted more of a headline than than a real agreement here."
In July, the FTC, Los Angeles County and Utah filed a lawsuit against Hims & Hers. It accused the company of sharing user health information with advertisers like Meta and Snap, charging for prescriptions before customers have spoken with a healthcare provider and making it hard to cancel subscriptions.
Dudum defended the telehealth provider's business model, saying it is built around increasing access to care.
"We are active disruptors. We take that head on, and we're willing to do it. But it is always when we believe that it's in the best interest of people and their access," said Dudum.
The Hims & Hers CEO also weighed in on the company's transition from compounded to branded GLP-1 drugs. When popular obesity and weight loss drugs were in shortage in recent years, the company could legally sell copycat versions at a discount.
After supply recovered, Novo Nordisk sued Hims & Hers for patent infringement. In March, the Danish drugmaker dropped its suit and the telehealth company agreed to sell Novo's branded drugs on its platform.
That decision came at a time when Novo and its main rival Eli Lilly were cutting the prices of their GLP-1 drugs for patients paying out of pocket.
"Ultimately, we will always apply pressure to the system if we believe it's best for the consumer. And when we were compounding the GLP-1s, there was no affordable access to these therapeutics," said Dudum. "Now, what that did in the ecosystem is it showed consumers and the drug companies these medications can be brought to consumers at a price that everyone can afford."
Dudum said he ultimately sees prices for cash-paying patients dropping to $40 to $50 per month, from roughly $150 to $200 now, depending on the form of the medication.
Dudum also said he believes artificial intelligence will dramatically transform healthcare, and the company is increasing its investments to ultimately go "AI native." Dudum said Hims & Hers is moving away from third-party AI agents to build everything in house.
"The core foundational models, independent of a closed loop data set, are not that valuable. That's my honest opinion," said Dudum. "The closed loop data that you have within a healthcare system like Hims & Hers, that is the asset."

text:
IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，当地时间 8 月 17 日，微软向 Windows Insider Experimental（26H1）通道推送了 Build 28120.2738 预览版更新。
该版本移除了 WMIC 和 Drag Tray 功能，并对设置和放大镜进行了修复，但微软同时确认该版本存兼容性问题，安装后可能无法正常启动《绝地求生》等游戏。
IT之家注意到，Build 28120.2738 移除了 Windows 管理规范命令行工具（WMIC），微软表示这是对该工具长期弃用和移除计划的持续推进。
与此同时，基于 Insider 用户的反馈，该版本移除了拖拽托盘（Drag Tray）功能，微软称后续将公布未来替代方案的相关细节。
在 Bug 修复方面，该版本解决了此前因“系统 > 通知”页面操作导致设置应用崩溃的问题，并修复了部分 Insider 用户无法启动放大镜工具的故障。
在已知问题方面，微软确认该版本与《绝地求生》存在兼容性问题，安装该版本后，预览体验用户可能会无法启动游戏。隐藏，微软已设置了防护措施避免这部分用户误升级，并与游戏开发商魁匠团合作寻求解决方案。微软表示，将在获得相关信息后公布修复时间等更多细节。

text:
IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，据央视新闻今天报道，北京海淀警方近日侦破一起新型涉诈案件，不法分子受境外电诈团伙指使，潜入商场弱电间私装 VOIP“小黑盒”设备，盗用本地固话线路批量外呼诈骗电话。
IT之家从原报道获悉，一通信公司最近向警方报案，北京市公安局海淀分局的民警接到案情后迅速赶往事发现场。民警在现场发现，商场本来连接好的电话线被人拔掉了，外接了一台黑色设备，加一台白色路由器，然后再多了一个电源给黑色设备充电。
据技术人员检测，这些就是 VOIP 设备，俗称“小黑盒”。境外的电诈分子，通过非法盗接的 VOIP 设备，可以远程使用境内的固话号码向外拨打诈骗电话。群众一旦看到来电号码为本地固话，往往会放松警惕。
情况紧急，北京海淀分局反诈中心立即通过 96110 电话和直接上门的方式对当天异常外呼的数百个电话进行回访，最大限度劝阻群众避免上当。
同时通过现场勘查、公共视频追踪，警方发现，在案发前一天的傍晚，有一名男子潜入了该商场的弱电间，将办公固话线接入事先准备好的 VOIP 电诈设备。随后，警方将该男子田某抓获。
田某事后交代，自己受境外人员指使， 假扮通信公司员工 ，在各地商场和小区内寻找弱电箱、弱电间， 在里面架设电诈设备 。目前田某因涉嫌帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪，已被北京市公安局海淀分局依法刑事拘留。
警方表示，此前不法分子大多伪装工作人员，到居民家中私装涉诈设备实施犯罪，但随着反诈宣传的深入，近期不法分子开始变换作案场所，将黑手伸向商场、写字楼等容易进入的公共场所伺机作案。警方提示，如在弱电间等区域发现这种设备， 请及时报警 。

title: The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus is officially available in US, no middleman needed
rss_desc: Previous Fairphone models were available in the US via Murena, running Google-free software. Not this time.
text:
Search results for All search results Best daily deals Login Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Aug 18, 2026 — 7:00 AM ET
0 • Paul Jones / Android Authority Follow us on Google Discover Add us as preferred source TL;DR Fairphone has released the Fairphone Gen 6 Plus, the first model directly available in the US. Previous models in the US were sold via software firm Murena and ran the Google-free /e/OS Android fork. The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus costs $649 or £569.
Fairphone first made a splash over a decade ago by offering ethically built, repairable phones . The company has continued this trend over the years while also offering lengthy update commitments. It launched the Fairphone Gen 6 last year, and it’s now offering a mid-gen refresh of sorts. This is the Fairphone Gen 6 Plus, and it’s now officially available in the US.
Previous Fairphone models were available in the US via software company Murena and ran the firm’s Google-free /e/OS Android fork. However, the Fairphone Gen 6 Plus is officially available in the US via Fairphone.com and Amazon. This device also ships with the standard Google-equipped OS instead of /e/OS, complete with an in-house gallery app for the first time. Furthermore, Fairphone says the new phone is supported on AT&T and T-Mobile ‘s networks.
These devices have a reputation for repairability, and the Fairphone Gen 6 Plus offers the same repairable design as last year’s model. That means you can replace up to 12 parts with a single screwdriver, including the battery, USB-C port, display, and cameras. These parts range in cost from $7.99 for the SIM tray all the way up to $89.99 for the screen.
Another reason to get Fairphones is their lengthy software update policy . The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus matches its predecessor by promising software updates until 2033, with “at least” six Android OS upgrades. These phones aren’t usually quick on the update draw, but this should still be reassuring if you want to keep your phone for more than two or three years.
The new Fairphone also brings a few upgrades compared to its predecessor, namely the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and 12GB of RAM. By contrast, the Fairphone Gen 6 offered a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chip and 8GB of RAM. There isn’t a significant performance difference between the two chips, though.
Otherwise, you’re looking at a phone that’s mostly identical to the previous model. That means a 6.31-inch LTPO OLED screen, 256GB of storage, a 4,415mAh battery, 30W wired charging, and eSIM support. The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus also sports a 50MP main camera (LYTIA-700C, 1/1.56-inch), a 13MP ultrawide camera, and a 32MP selfie snapper. Other notable specs include a microSD card slot , a side fingerprint scanner, Gorilla Glass 7i on the front, and an IP55 rating. The latter rating means the phone can withstand dust and a splash, but not full immersion in fresh water. That’s an understandable trade-off given the modular design on offer.
The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus is available in Europe, the UK, and the US. Expect the phone to cost $649 or £569. Fairphone is also offering a range of accessories in the US for the first time, such as finger loops, lanyards, and card holders.

快科技8月18日消息，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone Ultra将于9月份正式亮相，该系列将首发搭载全新的A20 Pro芯片。
据爆料，苹果A20 Pro将首次采用台积电2nm工艺制程。作为台积电的重要客户，苹果此前还首发了台积电的3nm工艺制程。
对比上代，苹果A20 Pro的芯片性能提升18%，能效比提高30%。同时，该芯片还将采用全新的晶圆级WMCM封装工艺（快科技注：WMCM全称是Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module）。
简单来说，这项技术是在晶圆层面上将处理器、内存等多个芯片直接整合成一个高密度模块，然后再进行统一封装。与苹果此前使用的InFO-PoP垂直堆叠封装不同，WMCM采用了水平结构，这一变化带来了两大核心优势。
首先，性能更强。WMCM封装显著缩短了处理器与内存之间的物理距离，使数据传输更快、更高效。其次，能效更高。水平布局改善了散热条件，同时解除了对DRAM容量的限制，为搭载更大容量内存提供了可能。
总体而言，WMCM封装技术让A20 Pro芯片在性能与能效上实现了双重提升。得益于这些技术创新，苹果A20 Pro将成为行业内最强悍的手机芯片，其综合性能将全面超越竞品骁龙8E5以及联发科天玑9500。
再结合iOS 27自身的流畅属性，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone Ultra在性能表现上值得期待。随着发布日期的临近，更多关于芯片和整机的细节也有望陆续揭晓。

title: 日澳扩大军事合作 日本计划在澳试射高超音速导弹
rss_desc: 中新网8月18日电 据日本共同社报道，当地时间18日，日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎在澳大利亚首都堪培拉与澳副总理兼国防部长理查德·马尔斯举行会谈。双方就日本自卫队为所谓“强化反击能力(对敌基地攻击能力)”在澳境内试射远程导弹事宜达成一致。
text:
中新网 8月18日电 据日本共同社报道，当地时间18日，日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎在澳大利亚首都堪培拉与澳副总理兼国防部长理查德·马尔斯举行会谈。双方就日本自卫队为所谓“强化反击能力(对敌基地攻击能力)”在澳境内试射远程导弹事宜达成一致。
双方在会谈中就一系列防务合作进行磋商。据报道，包括高超音速导弹在内，若在日本国内进行试验存在困难，将推进利用澳大利亚的试验场。双方还同意进一步扩大防务装备领域合作，包括推动澳方引进日本的升级版“最上”级护卫舰等。
据俄罗斯卫星通讯社报道，马尔斯在联合记者会上说：“今天我们商定推动澳大利亚和日本之间的一项更加完善和扩展的机制，以便在未来十年内，日本能够使用我国的导弹试验场，用于开展包括日本高超音速导弹项目在内的导弹测试。”
小泉进次郎指出，能在澳大利亚进行高超音速导弹等远程导弹试射，将成为双边合作的全新阶段。
近年来，日本与澳大利亚持续强化防务合作。4月18日，日本与澳大利亚签署协议，确认出口“最上”级护卫舰，这是二战后日本首次出口具备杀伤能力的大型海军舰艇。日本系列强军扩武的动向引发广泛批评。

快科技8月18日消息， 根据TrendForce集邦咨询最新NAND Flash产业研究，2026年第二季度AI服务器采购需求保持稳健，尤以Enterprise SSD最为旺盛，推动整体NAND Flash市场呈现供不应求格局，原厂借此大幅调涨产品平均销售单价（ASP）。
受此带动，前五大NAND Flash厂商合计营收环比增长77%，达688.7亿美元。
展望第三季度，尽管智能手机与PC终端因BOM成本上升导致整机售价走高、消费动能偏弱，但AI服务器对Enterprise SSD的需求仍将保持强劲。
同时，原厂资本支出普遍优先投向DRAM/HBM，NAND Flash新增产能有限，预计第三季ASP将继续支撑产业整体营收增长。
厂商表现方面， 三星电子以230.6亿美元营收位居榜首，环比增长70.7%，主要受益于AI服务器需求拉升NAND Flash ASP及Enterprise SSD出货占比持续提升，获利能力大幅改善。 不过，因同业增长更为迅猛，三星第二季市占率小幅下滑至29.3%。
SK海力士位列第二，得益于321层制程持续放量，以及Solidigm大容量QLC Enterprise SSD订单畅旺，ASP攀升推动其NAND Flash营收环比增长89.5%，达142.7亿美元，营业利润率再创新高。
美光科技同样因ASP显著成长，NAND Flash营收达118.5亿美元，环比增幅高达99.2%，在前五大厂商中增速最快，排名升至第三。
铠侠位居第四，受益于NAND Flash价格持续高企及BiCS8产出稳步放量，营收与获利双双走高，环比增长79.9%，达107.2亿美元，但市占率微降至13.6%。
闪迪方面，第二季ASP虽受AI需求拉动，但位元出货动能相对保守，营收环比增长50.7%，达89.7亿美元，整体成长节奏落后于同业。

title: 小米手机连续24个季度全球前三！高端化新进展：国内3000元以上占32.1%

快科技8月18日消息， 星海V6首台搭载华为乾崑智驾ADS 5 SE的量产车，今日在东风柳汽乘用车总装车间正式下线。
而价格是这台车最大的杀手锏，星海V6定位大六座纯电SUV，此前已公布预售价：
400km乾崑尊享型10.49万元，510km乾崑旗舰型12.49万元，将于9月正式上市。 这意味着华为乾崑智驾的价格门槛，首次被打到了10万级，填补了普惠型智驾大六座的市场空白。
据介绍，星海V6搭载华为乾崑智驾ADS 5 SE，采用10颗摄像头+12颗超声波雷达+3颗毫米波雷达的纯视觉融合方案，虽然没有激光雷达， 但依旧支持高速领航辅助NCA、城区车道巡航辅助LCC+、覆盖160余种场景的泊车辅助以及CAS 5.0全维主动安全。
与市场同级车型相比，10万元的版本普遍只有L2级辅助驾驶，仅支持高速ACC自适应巡航等功能，而星海V6直接跃迁至华为ADS 5 SE，辅助驾驶优势明显。
除了辅助驾驶外，星海V6本身的产品力表现也相当越级，车身尺寸为4835 x 1900×1755mm，轴距2900mm，采用2+2+2纯正六座布局，二排独立座椅腿部空间960mm、靠背最大145°后仰，三排中央通道宽240mm、腿部810mm。
车内还配备了同级独有的第三排下沉式收纳，六座满员后备厢仍有513L，能塞下6个20寸行李箱；收起第三排切换四座， 配合二排前移可释放1.63㎡纯平空间、最大1630L装载容积，外加70L前备箱，同时还提供七座车型可选。
“可四可六大平层”对大多数时间两三个人用车、节假日又拉全家的中国家庭来说，比单纯卷第三排参数更实用。
续航方面，新车搭载六合一高效电驱，电机最大功率135kW、峰值扭矩260N·m，提供45.5kWh和60.5kWh两种电池，CLTC续航400km与510km。
据官方介绍，东风柳汽与华为自2019年起围绕产品开发与IPD流程变革展开协同，今年6月7日在东风柳汽品牌客户日正式签署乾崑智驾合作，8月14日双方再签智能化制造工厂共建协议， 星海V6正是这一串签约落地的首个成果。
从行业来看，此前搭载华为乾崑智驾的车型起步价没有低于15万的，ADS 5 SE首次下探10万级，等于把“智驾平权”从口号变成了能上路的真车。而星海V6的出现，相当于又把高阶智驾的桌掀了，倒逼友商高阶辅助驾驶继续下放。

新品搭载BGM-31核心，分为Arc Pro B65和Arc Pro B70两款型号，其中Arc Pro B70为目前英特尔性能最强的工作站显卡，官方建议零售价（MSRP）为949美元。
然而，近期英伟达与AMD显卡价格大幅攀升，英特尔产品虽相对低调，却同样未能幸免。 自7月底至8月初，全球各地Arc Pro B70几乎在一夜之间全面调价，但涨幅因地区而异——美国上涨约30%，欧洲约26%，韩国则高达48%。
规格方面，Arc Pro B70配备32组Xe核心、4096个流处理器及256个XMX引擎，核心频率最高可达2800MHz，峰值算力达367 TOPS。
显存配置为32GB GDDR6 ECC，位宽256-bit，带宽达608 GB/s。整卡功耗范围为160~290W，其中英特尔公版卡功耗为230W。

快科技8月18日消息，近期DIY硬件全线涨价已经成为圈内共识，不少玩家都在感慨硬件价格疯涨，导致攒机成本居高不下，可硬件价格到底涨到了什么程度，对比一下今年和去年的装机预算就知道了。
根据电脑吧评测室统计数据， 原本定位于4000至5000元的主流配置，实际价格已全面跨入6000元区间，部分中高端配置的涨幅甚至超过了70%。
在具体配置方面，原本去年仅需4500元即可拿下的i5-13400F搭配RTX 5060入门款装机方案，目前总价已上浮至6300元，涨幅约为42.5%。
其中i5-13400F散片价格从695元上涨至900元左右，RTX 5060显卡则从2399元起步价普遍上调至3299元以上，单项涨幅均超过30%。
针对中高端用户，去年6500元预算可配置R5-7500F搭配RTX 5060 Ti 16GB版本，目前受存储溢价影响，同类配置的整机报价已来到11339元，涨幅高达72.1%。
其中16GB显存版的RTX 5060 Ti单卡价格已突破5400元大关，其市场溢价甚至超过了去年的高阶型号RTX 5070。
高端市场方面，i5-14600KF搭配RTX 5070的方案已从去年的8500元涨至13662元，涨幅为61.6%，受上游芯片代工成本上涨影响，RTX 5070的起步价已对标去年的RTX 5070 Ti，单显卡溢价普遍在2200元左右。
此外固态硬盘的价格也经历了翻倍式上涨，512GB容量的SSD单价已从去年同期的不足250元上涨至500元以上，每GB单价从不足0.5元跨越至1元大关。
内存方面价格更是突破天际， 全新DDR4 3200双通道套条普遍突破700元，2×8GB DDR4 3200三星颗粒版本现价729元，较去年同期上涨470元。
DDR5内存往年普通时序32GB DDR5 6000套条价格区间仅400-600元，当前同规格产品普遍2800元起步。
目前DIY市场的性价比逻辑已不复存在，挑配件、等快递的乐趣正被高昂的成本所抵消，未来几个月内装机成本是否会继续探底仍是未知数，玩家需谨慎评估入场时机。

title: 申请5000辆 结果只批10辆！特斯拉Robotaxi车队在内华达州被带紧箍咒
rss_desc: 快科技8月18日消息，据Electrek报道，  特斯拉在内华达州部署Robotaxi车队的计划遭遇“缩水式”审批——申请5000辆，最终只获批10辆。    据悉，今年6月初，特斯拉Robotaxi LLC向内华达州交通管理局提交申请，寻求获得自动驾驶车辆网络公司（AVNC）许可，覆盖整个克拉克县，计划首年投放最多5000辆车，还将哈利·里德国际机场和亨德森行政机场这两个高价值目的地列为接驳点。  然而内华达州交通管理局7月27日签署的许可大幅缩水， 仅允许10辆全自动驾驶车辆运营，并且活动范围限定在监管机构审批的地理围栏内，最高时速45英里（约72公里），同时禁止在机场接客。   许可还附加了多项条件，每辆车必须标注“robotaxi”标识，乘客需被告知乘坐的是无人驾驶车辆，行程需有“适当的人工监督”，一旦发生事故、系统故障或车辆瘫痪，须在5个工作日内上报。  若要扩大车队规模超过10辆，必须重新向管理局申请审批。目前，内华达州监管机构尚未公开解释5000辆的申请变成10辆许可的原因。  作为对比，亚马逊旗下Zoox持有内华达州第001号AVNC许可，7月16日的最新修订授权其运营

快科技8月18日消息，据Electrek报道， 特斯拉在内华达州部署Robotaxi车队的计划遭遇“缩水式”审批——申请5000辆，最终只获批10辆。
据悉，今年6月初，特斯拉Robotaxi LLC向内华达州交通管理局提交申请，寻求获得自动驾驶车辆网络公司（AVNC）许可，覆盖整个克拉克县，计划首年投放最多5000辆车，还将哈利·里德国际机场和亨德森行政机场这两个高价值目的地列为接驳点。
然而内华达州交通管理局7月27日签署的许可大幅缩水， 仅允许10辆全自动驾驶车辆运营，并且活动范围限定在监管机构审批的地理围栏内，最高时速45英里（约72公里），同时禁止在机场接客。
许可还附加了多项条件，每辆车必须标注“robotaxi”标识，乘客需被告知乘坐的是无人驾驶车辆，行程需有“适当的人工监督”，一旦发生事故、系统故障或车辆瘫痪，须在5个工作日内上报。
若要扩大车队规模超过10辆，必须重新向管理局申请审批。目前，内华达州监管机构尚未公开解释5000辆的申请变成10辆许可的原因。
作为对比，亚马逊旗下Zoox持有内华达州第001号AVNC许可，7月16日的最新修订授权其运营不超过100辆车，目前在拉斯维加斯大道上实际运行约50辆，并已于本月开始收费载客。
Waymo和Uber旗下Aviari Services也分别于6月和7月提交了内华达州申请，目前待批。特斯拉是第三家拿到许可的自动驾驶运营商，但一上来就要求50倍于Zoox车队规模的计划已经落空。
此外，值得一提的是，特斯拉全美无人监督Robotaxi车队同时在线运营的车辆大约只有20辆，奥斯汀峰值时近25辆，此后还在下滑。 也就是说，即便内华达州批了5000辆，特斯拉也没有那么多能跑的车。
目前，特斯拉Cybercab的生产速度已经超过了部署能力，马斯克也承认Robotaxi项目要到2027年才能产生实质性收入，而这个时间表他已经推迟了大约十年。

title: Readers’ favorite Galaxy Watch 9 alternative might come as a surprise
rss_desc: No, it's not a Pixel Watch or an older Galaxy Watch.
text:
Search results for All search results Best daily deals Login Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Smartwatches Readers' favorite Galaxy Watch 9 alternative might come as a surprise No, it's not a Pixel Watch or an older Galaxy Watch. By Andy Walker • Aug 18, 2026 — 7:48 AM ET
0 • Kaitlyn Cimino / Android Authority Follow us on Google Discover Add us as preferred source It’s been a few weeks since the Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 series debuted, bringing Wear OS fans a brand-new smartwatch for fitness tracking and beyond.
Although the new $380 device includes additional smart features and hardware, it’s also a little pricier this year. Its premium is even more apparent when compared to the Galaxy Watch 8 ‘s sale price, which regularly dips to around $300 at major retailers.
Zac Kew-Denniss / Android Authority As a consumer, you can choose to accept this price increase or look for something else. So what do our readers believe is the best Galaxy Watch 9 alternative? My colleague Roydon Cerejo offered up his five candidates , and in a poll running alongside his feature article, we asked you to vote for your favorite.
So, which device won the contest? Well, the winner may come as a surprise to many — it certainly did me.
This was a remarkably tight race. We received just under 2,300 votes here, but four devices were in the running for the best Galaxy Watch 9 alternative.
Andy Walker / Android Authority The winner isn’t Samsung or Google, but Garmin. 22.9% of respondents voted for the Garmin Venu 4 as their preferred alternative to the Galaxy Watch 9.
For the most part, the Venu 4 isn’t as “smart” as Wear OS equivalents, lacking the OS integration and app suite that Google’s platform offers. However, the Venu 4 certainly impresses in its health and wellness tracking feature suite, offers greater battery endurance than the Galaxy Watch 9, and offers a choice between two body sizes.
In second place, with 22.3% and just 12 votes behind, comes the Pixel Watch 4 . Notably, this survey was conducted before the release of the fifth-generation model , yet it indicates that Google’s smartwatch line remains one of the fiercest rivals to the Galaxy Watch series.
A surprise third-place finisher (20.7%) is the Amazfit Balance 2 . Arguably a better product on paper with its 32GB of internal storage and three-week battery life, the Balance 2 is a steal for $300. However, those who aren’t fond of Amazfit’s health-tracking software might be put off.
Brady Snyder / Android Authority Bringing up the rear are Samsung’s two previous smartwatch models. The Galaxy Watch 8 received 19% of the vote, while the Watch 7 accrued 9.9%. When their results are combined, one could argue that more readers would prefer to purchase an older Galaxy Watch over an alternative from another firm, but given that both watches fall behind the likes of Garmin, Google, and Amazfit, the results could also suggest that Samsung’s wearables are slowly losing their appeal.
A further 5.2% of respondents see none of the listed devices as worthwhile Galaxy Watch 9 alternatives, and offered their own recommendations in the comments. Devices mentioned include the OPPO Watch X3, the HUAWEI GT6 41mm, and the Garmin Venu 3.

If not, what would you buy instead? Let’s discuss in the comments.

快科技8月18日消息， 英特尔今日正式发布锐炫显卡驱动101.8974 WHQL版，该驱动核心针对搭载英特尔锐炫核显的酷睿Ultra 300处理器及锐炫B系列独显进行了深度优化，最高性能提升幅度达13%。
据官方测试数据显示，在搭载锐炫核显的酷睿Ultra 300平台上，《刺客信条：英灵殿》在1080p中画质下平均帧数提升约7%，高画质下提升幅度则达到了11%。
另一款作品《模拟农场2022》的优化效果更为显著，中画质下提升达13%，高画质下也有9%的增长。
此外锐炫B系列独显在《天国：拯救2》的1080p极高画质设定下，也实现了5%的平均帧数上涨。
除了性能飞跃，新驱动还修复了多项困扰玩家的画面Bug，其中《GTA V》在后处理效果设为非常高或极致时出现的物体模糊问题已得到解决。
针对《极限竞速：地平线6》的反射效果表现不佳、《侏罗纪世界：进化3》的水面闪烁问题，英特尔也在此次更新中完成了修复。
值得注意的是，本次更新对老用户同样友好， 驱动修复了第一代及第二代酷睿Ultra处理器在运行《怪物猎人：荒野》时的启动闪退故障，并解决了《我的世界》Java版在使用CapFrameX或RTSS监测工具时可能导致的程序崩溃。
不过新版驱动仍存在部分已知问题，英特尔提醒，开启XeSS多帧生成功能后，若同时使用CapFrameX或RTSS，部分游戏仍可能发生崩溃。
同时在运行《马拉松》时开启各向异性过滤可能会导致物体画面错误，Procyon与Geekbench的AI基准测试也存在潜在的闪退风险。

快科技8月18日消息，智能飞行影像品牌 哈浮推出全新产品VERSA飞行口袋云台相机。新品首发定价2999元起 ，现已开启全渠道预售。
作为继2022年爆款飞行相机X1后的又一重磅创新，VERSA采用可拆卸模块化设计， 实现手持云台相机与飞行相机双形态自由切换 ，有效解决用户“选云台相机还是无人机”的两难问题。
设备融合手持第一人称、平视第三人称与高空俯瞰多重视角，以一体化轻量化形态，大幅降低全维度影像创作的设备成本与携带负担。
VERSA最大的核心亮点，是创新的模块化双形态架构，无需复杂设置，即可快速切换两种专业拍摄模式，兼顾便携性与影像专业性。
手持状态下，VERSA是一台轻量化三轴机械云台口袋相机。设备搭载1.64英寸OLED视网膜屏，配备触觉震动反馈，操作精准灵敏。
旋启屏幕即可快速启动拍摄，单手可完成录制、变焦、自拍切换等操作，还可通过五维摇杆灵活操控云台。
凭借稳定的机械云台防抖能力，无论是动态行走跟拍，还是静态画面抓拍，均能输出平稳纯净的专业画面，适配各类日常手持拍摄场景。
如需空中拍摄视角，用户只需扣合专用飞行套件，设备即刻切换为智能飞行相机。
延续哈浮零门槛飞行体验，支持手掌起飞、无遥控自主飞行，搭载成熟AI智能运镜技术，可自动完成多角度拍摄。
该设计彻底打通地面与空中的创作边界，让普通用户也能轻松获取传统设备难以实现的高空立体视角。
影像硬件层面，VERSA实现全面升级，搭载1/1.3英寸传感器，搭配动态范围增强技术，最高支持17.5档超高动态范围。
设备内置四球减振结构，可有效吸收手持移动、飞行过程中的颠簸抖动，保障双形态拍摄下的画面稳定。
录制规格上，VERSA支持4K/60fps超高清视频录制，兼容10-bit HDR、H-Log及DNG等专业影像格式，保留丰富的高光与暗部细节，满足专业创作者后期调色与精细化影像创作需求。
同时视频支持Open Gate片门全开录制，充分利用传感器完整成像区域，摆脱传统16:9裁切限制，完整记录画面原始信息，为后期裁剪、二次构图预留充足创作空间。
此外，VERSA新增“盗梦空间”电影级拍摄模式，手持、飞行双形态均可启用。 依托高精度三轴云台旋转能力，实现画面地平线平缓翻转，打造极具质感的沉浸式镜头效果。
以往该类高阶镜头仅能通过专业设备和复杂后期制作完成，VERSA 将其内置为一键拍摄模式，大幅降低专业创意影像的创作门槛。
除硬件形态创新外，VERSA搭载4nm旗舰AI芯片，依托高性能NPU算力，实现端侧实时计算摄影。
拍摄时，AI自动构图系统可实时识别人物、风景、静物等各类场景，智能分析画面布局，微调云台角度、优化画面裁切，自动校正构图，新手也能轻松拍出均衡高级的成片。
创作后期，AI自动剪辑功能可智能筛选手持、飞行双视角素材，自动匹配转场、编排片段，快速生成完整视频，大幅简化剪辑流程，提升创作效率。
在空间影像领域，VERSA借助智能环绕飞行与3D高斯点阵重建技术，设备可自主环绕拍摄并重建真实三维场景，完整还原场景景深与空间细节。
用户可通过配套APP自由切换浏览视角，同时支持一键分享，打破传统平面视频的展示局限，实现影像的可沉浸可交互。
对于Vlogger、旅行爱好者、家庭用户而言，一台VERSA即可替代传统云台相机与航拍无人机，有效减轻设备携带压力。

展会共邀请两岸参展企业224家，展品涵盖林竹加工、森林食品、林下经济、农林智能装备等全产业链条，有效拓宽产业对外合作渠道与产品外销市场。
开馆式上，中国竹产业协会发布竹基倾转旋翼无人机、竹基全生物降解新材料、金钢竹托盘等5项“以竹代塑”最新科技成果，为“以竹代塑”创新发展拓宽路径，也为三明延伸竹产业链、推动竹产业高质量发展带来全新机遇。
产业发展，人才为本，智库先行。现场还为竹木产业链专家团队发起人、科技特派员集中颁发聘书，为林业高质量发展汇聚智力支撑。
践行绿色办展理念，本届林博会主办方认购“福建金森200吨林业碳票”，用于全额抵消展会碳排放，实现碳中和目标。同时，三明本土碳汇数字平台——“碳小元”微信小程序正式上线，助力低碳绿色美好家园建设。
活动将持续至8月23日。期间，主办方将举办竹产业招商推介会、农林智能装备交流会等多项特色活动，深挖本土特色文化资源，搭建政企沟通、商贸合作、技术交流的优质平台，全方位助力林竹产业高质量发展。
两岸林博会是大陆唯一以林业为主题的两岸会展活动，已成功举办20届，成为推进两岸林业改革与发展、生态文明建设、乡村振兴等合作的重要平台。(完)

title: 四川震灾防减救一体化智能大模型“磐御”正式发布
rss_desc: 中新网成都8月18日电 (记者 刘忠俊)8月18日，四川省地震局、四川省测绘地理信息局、雅安市人民政府在蓉联合举行“震灾防减救一体化智能大模型‘磐御’”发布活动，省、市、县政府相关部门负责人、高校代表及行业专家参加。
text:
中新网 成都8月18日电 (记者 刘忠俊)8月18日，四川省地震局、四川省测绘地理信息局、雅安市人民政府在蓉联合举行“震灾防减救一体化智能大模型‘磐御’”发布活动，省、市、县政府相关部门负责人、高校代表及行业专家参加。
据了解，“磐御”以千亿级参数DeepSeek语义大模型为底座，是面向地震灾害风险防范领域的垂直行业大模型，覆盖震灾防、减、救全链条业务场景，聚焦震前风险防控和震后黄金72小时应急处置，致力于推动防震减灾工作由“被动应对”向“主动防御”转变。
“我们启动‘磐御’大模型研发工作，目的是打造适配四川区域特征的防减救一体化智慧大脑。”四川省震灾风险防治中心高级工程师、研究员郭红梅介绍，“磐御”是兼顾日常防灾减灾与震时应急救灾的“AI总指挥”。
“磐御”大模型依托全要素数据底座，融合风险感知数据，可进行智能评估和动态推演，并据此给出“该做什么、怎么做”的具体处置方案，助力防减救科学决策和快速响应。“灾害从来不会等待我们准备就绪，但科技能让我们更有底气地直面风险。”郭红梅表示。
“传统的经验式防控和滞后性响应，已难以满足民众对高质量地震安全的期待。”四川省地震局局长余书明表示，秉持“居安思危，思则有备，有备无患”的思想，省地震局与省测绘地理信息局深化合作，积极运用人工智能大模型前沿技术，着力构建“会听、会看、会思考”的智慧中枢——“磐御”大模型。
目前，该模型已在四川省石棉县全面落地应用，下一步将向省、市、县三级防震减灾主管部门及各行业系统提供灾害情景推演和辅助决策服务，推动形成“纵向到底、横向到边”的智能化防灾减灾应用网络，构建“感知一张网、推演一平台、指挥一盘棋”的智慧防震减灾新格局。(完)

title: 北京亦庄发布“AI人才八条” 为原生创业者打开新通道
rss_desc: 中新网北京8月18日电 (记者 杜燕)在今天举行的2026北京亦庄人才发展大会上，北京经济技术开发区(简称“北京经开区”，又称“北京亦庄”)发布《北京经济技术开发区关于支持人工智能原生人才发展的若干措施》(以下简称“AI人才八条”)。该政策聚焦人工智能人才创业、青年就业、生态培育三个核心维度，推出8条务实举措，构建起覆盖在校实习生到顶尖科学家的全链条人才引育留用体系。政策体系顺应人工智能人才年轻化、跨界化、组织轻量化等新趋势，创新人才认定机制及支持模式，为不同类型、不同阶段的人工智能原生人才构建共创共享的发展生态。
text:
中新网 北京8月18日电 (记者 杜燕)在今天举行的2026北京亦庄人才发展大会上，北京经济技术开发区(简称“北京经开区”，又称“北京亦庄”)发布《北京经济技术开发区关于支持人工智能原生人才发展的若干措施》(以下简称“AI人才八条”)。该政策聚焦人工智能人才创业、青年就业、生态培育三个核心维度，推出8条务实举措，构建起覆盖在校实习生到顶尖科学家的全链条人才引育留用体系。政策体系顺应人工智能人才年轻化、跨界化、组织轻量化等新趋势，创新人才认定机制及支持模式，为不同类型、不同阶段的人工智能原生人才构建共创共享的发展生态。
人工智能产业快速迭代，人才评价需要跳出传统路径。“AI人才八条”将支持对象精准聚焦于真正站在技术和产业前沿的核心力量，既包括世界一流人工智能科学家、全球头部大模型团队技术负责人，也包括拥有技术积累和市场经验的技术骨干、连续创业者、拔尖青年等人才，既关注人工智能原生人才，也为具备跨界创新能力的人才留足空间。
在精准识别人才的同时，更注重陪伴创业者发展，采取“成熟一个、评定一个、支持一个”的支持方式，给予全球顶尖人才优厚的创业启动资金和发展奖励，给予产业精英人才最高500万元资金支持，同步纳入亦城人才体系，获得算力集群、定制研发空间、产业场景对接等资源。通过前期启动、成长跟踪和后续激励相衔接，把支持嵌入企业从技术验证到产业化发展的全过程，让创业者在每一个关键阶段都能获得及时助力。
针对人工智能时代快速涌现的超级个体(OPC)，“AI人才八条”进一步创新评价机制，组建包含OPC代表的评审委员会，关注创业者的真实创造能力、闭环交付能力和发展潜力，对以轻组织形态运行的人工智能原生创业者，给予个人最高50万元奖励，探索设置创业过渡期社保接续及创业保险兜底机制，为从就业转向创业、从团队骨干转向超级个体的人才提供缓冲空间，构筑更有安全感、更具包容性的创业软环境。
青年人才是人工智能产业持续创新的生力军，北京亦庄正铺设一条从校园到职场的“黄金赛道”，让年轻人大胆想、大胆为。
顶尖实习生已经成为人工智能企业创新的关键力量，北京亦庄推出全市首个人工智能专项实习生支持举措，面向人工智能赛事获奖者、顶尖高校人工智能学子、拥有大模型深度研发实习经历的专业人才以及擅长提示词工程的文科背景人才等，给予实习补贴及就业奖励。
实习是入口，成长是关键。为了让青年人才不仅能“走进来”，还要能“走下去”；北京亦庄大力引培前沿部署工程师(FDE)人才，支持企业联合高校、科研院所探索协同育人机制，引进培育兼顾模型理解、工程落地与场景适配能力的系统工程人才矩阵，鼓励企业积极开发新岗位、吸纳新就业，持续增强人工智能转型与发展的内生驱动力，对成效突出的企业给予综合资助，构筑AI复合型人才高地。
对于刚从校园迈向职场的新青年，扎根即享“稳定礼包”。鼓励人工智能相关领域的企业引进全日制应届毕业生、出站博士后。对符合条件的青年人才，将在职业发展、生活保障等方面享受相应政策支持。同时，加速优化“亦庄半小时通勤生活圈”，完善多元化、阶梯式住房保障体系，让青年人才安心扎根成长。
人工智能创新不是少数人的“独角戏”，而是开发者、创业者、产业专家和跨界人才共同参与的“协奏曲”。相比单向度的人才引进，更要建设一个协作、包容、开放的人工智能社群，让人才在交流碰撞中贡献智慧、获得反馈、持续进化。
围绕这一目标，“AI人才八条”鼓励模型企业、工具平台、开源社区等共同发展创新生态，围绕模型迭代、智能体开发和产业应用开展跨界共创与开源实践，把分散的创新力量连接起来，形成开放共享、相互启发、自主成长的人才进化网络。
这一生态既需要专业高度，也需要接地气的创新活力。支持产业协会、科技媒体、开发者社区、高校等主体在区内举办人工智能赛事、黑客松、开发者大会、技术切磋会等活动，对符合条件的产业交流活动给予最高100万元支持。在这里，不同背景的人才都可以成为创新生态的发起者和参与者，通过更加活跃、更具参与感的社群网络，让人工智能不仅存在于实验室和产业园区，也融入城市日常，成为全域人工智能之城最鲜活的底色。
当前，北京经开区已聚集人工智能产业链核心企业800余家，产业规模突破1000亿元，正在加快建设具有全球影响力的全域人工智能之城。北京经开区有关负责人表示，人工智能原生人才政策要解决的，不只是人才“引进来”的问题，更要回答支持什么样的人才、怎样陪伴人才成长、如何让不同人才相互连接。希望通过更加精准的识别机制、贯穿成长周期的支持方式和开源开放的创新生态，让每一种人工智能创造力都能在亦庄找到生长空间，共同建设一座能够持续验证技术、不断孕育产业、主动重塑治理、充分激发创造力的全域人工智能之城。(完)

title: 特朗普：目前和未来不会与伊朗进行任何会谈或对话
rss_desc: 中新网8月18日电 当地时间18日，美国总统特朗普在社交媒体发文称，目前和未来不会与伊朗进行任何会谈或对话。
text:
中新网 8月18日电 当地时间18日，美国总统特朗普在社交媒体发文称，目前和未来不会与伊朗进行任何会谈或对话。
他还称，美国对伊朗的海上封锁依然全面有效，霍尔木兹海峡开放且正常运行，所有水雷已被清除或引爆。
据此前报道，特朗普17日在白宫对媒体称，伊朗不会达成他认为结束美伊战事所必需的协议，并且“应当投降”，而两国间的谈判仍处于停滞状态。
8月17日，美国和伊朗谅解备忘录所设定的60天谈判窗口期期满。双方6月中旬远程签署这一备忘录，承诺在60天内进行谈判并达成最终协议。当被问及美国是否打算延长与伊朗达成的谅解备忘录时，特朗普回答“不”。
此外，特朗普称，美国正通过封锁“完全”控制着霍尔木兹海峡，而且“我们每周都在运出数百万桶石油”。
